text:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 - Inference error-rate spike observed in az1a on /v1/generate (increased 5xx & timeouts). Alert threshold crossed at 04:12 UTC. Link: internal/incident/INC-4987.

alice_oncall: i'm on it, pulling dashboards and logs. react with :eyes: if you can monitor.

ben_sre: looking at resolver metrics in az1a — NXDOMAIN and SERVFAIL bursts from local resolver pool. Edge 5xx up to ~4% for some host buckets, cluster-wide ~0.6%. GRPC stream drops on a subset of frontends.

maria_infra: seeing anomalous negative-cache entries and kvcache eviction spikes on runtime nodes. recent resolver config rollout ~20m ago. possible split-brain between local resolver instances -> inconsistent answers.

dave_support: CS: multiple customers filing 502s and long tokenization times. Two enterprise tenants hitting >5% errors, others intermittent. CS drafting a banner and reaching out to those two.

alice_oncall: proposed mitigation steps (in order):
1) enable resolver fallback to regional DNS pool (quick failover)
2) flush runtime kvcache on frontends in small batches
3) shift 10% of inference traffic to eu-west-1 for headroom while we stabilize
I'll coordinate, call out when you execute.

ben_sre: executing fallback now via control-plane: `rctl resolver set --zone az1a --fallback-region eu-west-1 --enable` (this flips resolver precedence, no infra deploy). Doing a rolling flip.

deploy-bot: Action queued: set resolver-fallback flag for az1a (requested by ben_sre).

maria_infra: starting kvcache flush for first 20 frontends: `kubectl -n inference exec -c runtime $(kubectl get pods -l app=inference -o name | head -n 20) -- /usr/local/bin/flush_kv.sh` — running now, will watch kvcache miss/regen metrics. Doing in batches to avoid thundering herd.

alice_oncall: initiating traffic weight change: rotator -> set weights az1a=90 eu-west-1=10; doing 10% now to limit blast radius.

dave_support: posted provisional customer message to status.redwood.ai: "We are investigating increased 502s for inference in a single AZ; fallback routing has been enabled and some traffic is being shifted. We'll update shortly." CS notified account teams.

ben_sre: quick update: after fallback flip, observed error rate drop from ~0.6% -> 0.12% in 5m. Some latency variance as kvcache warms, but 5xxs mostly gone.

maria_infra: kvcache flush completed for batch 1, miss-rate spiked then stabilized. CPU on some frontends increased briefly; autoscaler handled it. Continuing next batch.

alice_oncall: good. keep fallback enabled until root cause fixed. creating INC-4987 root cause ticket and assigning to maria_infra for follow-up.

maria_infra: hypothesis: resolver config push contained inconsistent SOA/TTL leading to split responses and negative caching. Plan: rollback the change, add canary/validation, and harden TTL handling in resolver bootstrap. I'll own the postmortem and a short remediation PR.

deploy-bot: resolver-fallback flag set by ben_sre at 4987654360.

ben_sre: leaving now, handing live pager to carol_oncall in 30m. Notes: watch for kvcache regen CPU spikes and any residual NXDOMAIN bursts.

carol_oncall: ack, will take in 30. can you paste any relevant logs or grep commands?

alice_oncall: saving graphs + grep examples to the ticket: `grep -i "servfail\|nxdomain" /var/log/resolver/az1a/*.log | tail -n 200` and `promql: sum(rate(inference_5xx_total[5m])) by (az)`

dave_support: CS: two enterprise customers will need SLA follow-up; raising incident severity for account ops.

incident-bot: Incident severity reduced to SEV3 (mitigation in place, error rate low) at 04:23 UTC.

alice_oncall: leaving detailed handoff notes in INC-4987: current state — fallback in place, traffic 10% shifted, kvcache flush in progress, rollback PR drafted. next: maria to rollback config + ship canary, carol to monitor.

carol_oncall: thanks — i'll pick this up. please DM if anything regresses.
